title: 2027 Lexus NX Hybrid Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The Lexus NX Hybrid is heavily updated for the 2027 model year, with a revised hybrid powertrain, refreshed styling, a beefed-up chassis, and upgraded infotainment and safety tech.
body_markdown:
The Lexus NX gets a comprehensive refresh for 2027 and now features a hybrid or plug-in hybrid powertrain, a more rigid chassis, and the latest technology features. The NX competes with popular models such as the Acura RDX, the Audi Q5, the BMW X3, the Genesis GV70, the Mercedes-Benz GLC, and the Volvo XC60. This article covers the hybrid-powered Lexus NX 350h.

## What’s New for the 2027 Lexus NX Hybrid


While not exactly all-new, the Lexus NX 350h has been heavily updated for the 2027 model year. In addition to its new hybrid powertrain, the NX 350h features refreshed styling inside and out, a beefed-up chassis that Lexus claims improves driving dynamics, an upgraded infotainment system, and improved safety equipment.


## Design


The 2027 NX 350h is immediately recognizable as a Lexus. Its bold spindle-shaped grille, deeply sculpted bodysides, and high-tech lighting signatures give it an upscale look. The Lexus NX is offered in Premium, Premium+, F Sport, and Luxury trim levels, with the F Sport standing out from the rest with extra exterior aerodynamic elements, blacked-out roof rails and rear spoiler, and unique 20-inch wheels.


## Powertrain


The 2027 Lexus NX 350h is equipped with an updated version of the brand’s familiar hybrid powertrain. It now makes an extra four horsepower and is also said to offer smoother acceleration that feels more like an electric car's. Power comes from a 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine that’s mated directly to an electric motor and a continuously variable automatic transmission (CVT). Models equipped with all-wheel drive (AWD) feature an additional electric motor that powers the rear wheels. In either case, Lexus rates the NX 350h at 244 horsepower. The 2027 Lexus NX Hybrid is rated to tow up to 2,000 pounds.


## Interior


The Lexus NX has a cleanly styled interior. Most controls are handled through the touchscreen, but there is a line of buttons below it, along with multi-purpose buttons on the steering wheel. Electronic buttons are used to open the doors from the inside, which may take some getting used to. Lexus also offers a Sensory Concierge experience in Luxury and F Sport models that includes preset illumination, music, climate control, seat temperature, and even fragrance settings.


## Technology


Every 2027 Lexus NX 350h comes standard with a 12.3-inch display that serves as a digital gauge cluster and a 14-inch infotainment touchscreen. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are supported, and a wireless device charger is also included. An integrated Drive Recorder (more commonly known as a dashcam) is standard. A 10-speaker Lexus Premium Audio system comes standard on Premium, Premium+, and F Sport models. Luxury trim adds a 17-speaker, 1,800-watt Mark Levinson PurePlay Surround Sound system, and the upgraded system is also available as an option on the F Sport. An active Remote Connect trial or subscription gives access to the Lexus Digital Key 2.0 system that lets drivers use their smartphones as digital keys. A Drive Connect trial or subscription provides access to Lexus Cloud Navigation, Destination Assist, and Intelligent Assistant, which responds to a “Hey Lexus” command.

## Safety


The latest Lexus Safety System+ 4.0 is standard on all 2027 NX 350h models. It includes such driver-assistance features as adaptive cruise control, automatic emergency braking, lane-keep assist, lane-departure warning, traffic-sign recognition, high-beam assist, and more. Additional options include traffic-jam assist, lane-change assist, rear pedestrian detection, and front cross-traffic alert. The 2027 Lexus NX had not been tested for crashworthiness at the time of writing, but the 2026 model that shared much of the same structure was awarded a Top Safety Pick+ by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety.


## Pricing and Release Date


Lexus had not released pricing information for the 2027 NX 350h SUV at the time of writing. For reference, last year’s NX 350h started at $46,570. We wouldn’t expect the starting price to rise drastically, but considering the improvements Lexus has made to the 2027 model, including an upgraded powertrain, new styling, new infotainment, and additional safety equipment, it’s reasonable to expect a slight increase for the new model year.
